text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O and I are heading back to
the
academy when she suddenly stops.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you remember the princess in
pajamas,
yes?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The princess in pajamas? She must be
talking
about the fan who sneaked out
from the hospital
to meet her.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Her surgery is tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It is simple. We go and shine my
gorgeous smile
upon her, first thing
tomorrow morning!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So the next day, we stop by the
hospital.
However...

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: I do apologize, but she's...

text_block_list.name: Nurse
text_block_list.text: You're too scared for the surgery?

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... Sob!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Princess, please, hold those tears at bay.
Your
eyes might soon spill out along
with them. Worry
not! I shall bear your
lamentation.

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text: O-Opera O?!

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Hic! I-I'm sorry! I tried really, really hard but... I... I ran away!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Princess...

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text: I'll never... I'll never be like you!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Alas, Princess. That is only natural.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I am the one and only me, after all...
Still!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I shall say unto you now!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I am T.M. Opera O, the Centurial
Overlord!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
O fair Princess Pajamas, fear not! For I
know your
true strength!

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text: Opera O...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Dearest friend! Are her tears a sign of
weakness?
What is the meaning held
within them? Tell me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The meaning behind her tears? The
question
catches me off guard, but I
understand how
important the answer
will be.

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text: Courage? ...But, I'm crying.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! Tears are required for the
courage to
take a stand!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Not weakness, but a spirit rising to
challenge
what lies before you!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, rise, Princess! Meet the challenge
head on!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Defeat the dragon!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Opera O is looking right at me. That can
only
mean "the dragon" is my part to
play.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That dragon is your weakness incarnate!
Go forth
and settle this once and for all!

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text: O-okay! But... how?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You already have a weapon into which a
great
radiant light was infused.

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text: Gasp! The mirror!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That's it! Now, take aim at the dragon!
Your
sacred determination shall rend
any monster
asunder!

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text: Hiyaaah!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: ...Hello?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Dragon! That was your cue!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the dragon is defeated at the
hands of
the little girl.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Princess, it would seem you no longer
have use
for an escort.

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text:
I... can go by myself! I won't run away
again!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Very good. I bid you adieu for now, o
fair and
courageous princess.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to. Your dragon was
convincing
enough.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A letter arrives from the girl a few days
later. She
says that the surgery was
successful and she wants
to return the
mirror. Also...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's planning to drop it off herself, but
wearing
daytime clothes this time.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ahh, indeed! Regret is the source of her
pain!
These are tears of one who yearns
to move
onward!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That is why they shine so bright! They
desperately
grasp at hope!

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text: ...Opera O!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That struggle itself is the strength to
press
onward! Now, Princess! The time to
rise has come!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Defeat the Demon Lord of Gloom!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Opera O is looking right at me. That can
only
mean "the demon lord" is my part
to play.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: The Demon Lord is your fear incarnate! Show all that stand in your way that you will press onward!

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text: O-okay! But... how?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You already have a weapon into which a
great
radiant light was infused.

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text: Gasp! The mirror!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That's it! Now, take aim at the demon!
Your
sacred determination shall rend
any monster
asunder!

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text: Hiyaaah!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You demonic foe... Look upon the
princess's light!
May it illuminate you
and bring peace to the
world!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hehe, nicely done, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the evil lord is defeated at the
hands of
the little girl.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Princess, it would seem you no longer
have use
for an escort.

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text:
I... can go by myself! I won't run away
again!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Very good. I bid you adieu for now, o
fair and
courageous princess.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Please, do not let it sour your mood.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: A demon lord and the Overlord are both lords, hence their name. Not a bad pairing, if you ask me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A letter arrives from the girl a few days
later. She
says that the surgery was
successful and she wants
to return the
mirror. Also...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's planning to drop it off herself, but
wearing
daytime clothes this time.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! To have doubt is what it means to
have life,
Princess! Those doubts are
what will make you
strong!

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text: Doubts... make me strong?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! And they lay out the path
before you!
Thus, it is fine that your path
differs from mine!

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text: So... it's my own path.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, rise, Princess! Meet the challenge
head on!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Defeat the phantom fog clouding your
path
forward!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Opera O is looking right at me. That can
only
mean "the phantom fog" is my part
to play.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The fog is all the things that have ever
frightened
you! Go forth and settle this
once and for all!

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text: O-okay! But... how?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You already have a weapon into which a
great
radiant light was infused.

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text: Gasp! The mirror!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That's it! Now, take aim at the phantom
fog! Your
sacred determination shall
rend any monster
asunder!

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Princess, do not avert your eyes! You
have what it
takes to win!

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Nngh... Hiyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the phantom fog is defeated at
the hands
of the little girl.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Princess, it would seem you no longer
have use
for an escort.

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text:
I... can go by myself! I won't run away
again!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Very good. I bid you adieu for now, o
fair and
courageous princess.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The future is illuminated by a single,
brilliant
light. But we must each walk our
own path toward
it.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Thus, I must walk down the road to
victory—a
path for myself and my trainer
alone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A letter arrives from the girl a few days
later. She
says that the surgery was
successful and she wants
to return the
mirror. Also...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's planning to drop it off herself, but
wearing
daytime clothes this time.
